purpose: The ephemeral binds the launcher itself makes before the program that serves N binds N, and how it must treat each. Members come from ordinary use, not from an adversary: the OS hands out the same pool of ports N came from, so any of them can land on N. staging-port rows feed stagingPort a sequence of ports the OS hands out; stand-in rows feed checkStandIn the URL of the staging stand-in GitHub. The final stand-in GitHub is made inside the final program.Start, which binds N in the same call: it cannot be inspected beforehand, and its drawing N ends in a failed final bind (a loud exit 1), so it has no row. A job kill, an outside process taking N, and P taken between the pick and the bind are likewise loud exits, not rows.

the first draw is N itself: drawn again
